entities.summary: Frome Sugar Estate, a notable figure in the history of Jamaica, associated with Labour Movement, Marcus Garvey, and Self-Governance (1938–1944). Preceded by 1938 Labour Uprising and the Birth of Party Politics and Haile Selassie I. Their legacy influenced Universal adult suffrage and first elections 1944 and West Indies Federation.
